notes.title: Shark Castle Release and Developer Livestream
notes.notes:
Shark Castle is out now! Rescue your castle and your friends from pollution and Damian's robots, featuring stealth, puzzle platforming, and interesting side quests.

The game will be livestreamed for a short time beginning at 4PM EST. See you there!

notes.title: Shark Castle Demo Release
notes.notes:
The Shark Castle demo is available to play during the Steam Games Festival!

[h3]About Shark Castle[/h3]
Play as FInlay in an adventure game with puzzle and rpg elements. Navigate toxic pipes, avoid robots, and save your home!

In this demo, explore dungeons, swim through pipes, and meet friends as you make your way through a polluted castle.

[h3]Join the community[/h3]
More updates, including access to playtesting, will be available soon!
